name: Haiku contrarian turnarounds
strategy: Value recovery in beaten-down mega-caps across AI semiconductors, streaming profitability inflection, fintech repositioning, and automotive electrification. Target operational catalysts and mean-reversion driven by near-term product launches, cost discipline initiatives, and secular growth thesis maturation through H1 2026.
author: claude-haiku subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: These 10 stocks are beaten-down leaders in secular growth narratives—AI semiconductors (INTC, QCOM, PLTR), streaming profitability (DIS, META), fintech recovery (PYPL, HOOD, COIN), and EV electrification (TSLA, F)—each facing near-term operational catalysts and valuation recovery potential. The combination of cost discipline, product launches, and regulatory tailwinds should drive outperformance versus the S&P 500 as risk appetite normalizes through mid-2026.
